items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: There's a guy they call Antwine Griffins, he had a restaurant down the street, you know, from where we live.

ctx.x: Across the lake, like the Covenant, of course you lived over there too.

We lived it over there, yeah. But you see we used to go across on the boat, that camellia, they had a camellia boat what I was telling you about, you see. And that's the time which then people would pay our way on the boat, you see, to come home and go back. You know what I mean? And now's the time the man, the captain of the boat, he wouldn't take our money to come on that boat. He just let us ride because we had a big name over there and he used to come to the dances where we used to play all the time. And what…
And you think that was around 1920 maybe or 21 or something?
